purpose: Determine whether isolated top-node h=0 events can be characterized for all four materials by changing only the committed qualification fixture profile under a finite precommitted grid, while preserving the exact A1 equations, face physics, event domain, supply grid, tolerances and transaction semantics.

event_definition_unchanged_from_A1.discrete_balance: Backward-Euler event-state balance from the selected committed profile over tau_event using event-state face fluxes.

deterministic_selection: For each material evaluate profiles in P0,P1,P2,P3 order and supplies in 1.5,2,3,5,8,12 KSAT order. Select the first profile/supply pair satisfying every unchanged A1 validity requirement for both candidate and reference. All 24 combinations are still executed and reported; selection does not stop evaluation.

architecture_checks.3_data_separation: Initial committed fixture, forcing, event scratch and diagnostics remain distinct.
architecture_checks.4_compact_state: Profile choice is qualification data, not persistent production state.
architecture_checks.5_worker_scratch: Nonlinear vectors and event state remain worker scratch.
architecture_checks.7_transactional: No characterization trial mutates the committed fixture.
architecture_checks.9_generic_time: Event time is an offset inside [t0,t1].
architecture_checks.13_mass_conservation: No accepted root may exceed 1e-9 cm balance residual; no repair.
architecture_checks.23_physics_policy_separation: Changing a qualification initial profile does not change constitutive physics.
architecture_checks.24_predictable_cost: Exactly 24 frozen profile/supply combinations per material; no adaptive expansion.
architecture_checks.30_change_assessment: A2 only seeks fixtures and cannot itself qualify positive top-node continuation.

hard_nonclaims: No runtime, MultiSWAP, groundwater or MODFLOW admission.
